lines.zh: 我从墙里钻出来，沙落下。
lines.en: I come out of the wall, sand falling.
I flatten and dart out.
I enter the stone and come out again.
I leave a trail of fine sand.

lines.zh: 我贴着地皮窜，尘土跟着。
lines.en: I dart along the ground, dust trailing me.
I shoot past your feet.
I run, trailing motes.

lines.zh: 我钻进地里，从前面出来。
lines.en: I sink into the ground and surface ahead.
I dart around the stone's edge.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面往你那边去。
lines.en: I go low toward you.
I move through the sand, quick.
When I stop, the motes settle.
I lie under a stone, still.
My body is long and thin.

lines.zh: 我的门牙合不拢，一直露。
lines.en: My front teeth never meet; they show all the time.
I wait for the light to move.
I smell iron in the air.
I bury my face in the soil.
I claw at the ground.
I remember that patch of light.
I shudder, and sand slides off.
I'm afraid of bright places.
I hate that lamp in your hand.
I sink halfway into the stone.
Your shadow is enough to hide in.
I watch your feet, not your face.
One step from you and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，牙还露着。
lines.en: I lower my head, teeth still out.
There's too much light here.
You smell of sand.
I'm not looking for a fight.
Block the lamp, and I'll come out.
I sink halfway back into the wall.
I curl up, teeth still out.
I bite the stone and retreat.
That stopped me moving.
I shudder, and sand falls.
I don't cry out; I only want to hide.
I shift toward the dark.
A piece of my tail is gone, and it still writhes.

lines.zh: 我僵在石头边，连气都不出。
lines.en: I stiffen against the stone, not even breathing.
I can still burrow, slowly.
Put the lamp out, and I'll come near.
A little darker is better.
That thing in your hand clicks.
Blood smell, very near.
I shift half an inch your way.
Lower the lamp, and I'll poke my head out.
Only the dark is safe.
Put it in the corner.
Half an inch more and I'm within reach.
That glow stings; move it.
You hit me, and I'm halfway into the floor.
I retreat into the wall, only my head out.

lines.zh: 我们碰上，你手上的灯晃。
lines.en: We collide, and your lamp sways.
My teeth scrape your boot.
I circle you and sink through the other side.
Your foot pins my tail tip.
I hit the stone and bounce off.
One touch and I retreat; the light is too close.
Your shadow presses on me.
We part, and the soil still falls.
Another pokes its head from the wall.
Her teeth are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 两条长身子挤进同一道缝。
lines.en: Two long bodies squeeze into the same crack.
She pushes sand toward me.
We travel through the soil together.
Her body is softer than mine.
We face each other in the dark.
We wait for the light to go out.
Two long bodies, one sandy trail.
We don't call; we touch teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的箭，拖进土里。
lines.en: I bite your arrow and drag it under.
I push the bone along with my head.

lines.zh: 我挖出一块砂土，含在嘴里。
lines.en: I dig up sandy dirt and hold it.

lines.zh: 我把你的手套拖到墙角。
lines.en: I drag your glove into the corner.
I bite a cloth and shake it.
I pick up a pebble and swallow it.
I carry off the fallen pit.
I dig out an arrowhead.

lines.zh: 我把你的披风拽进裂缝。
lines.en: I pull your cloak into the crack.
I bite a root and snap it.
You set the lamp down; good.

lines.zh: 你的脚步从土上传下来。
lines.en: Your steps travel down through the soil.
This patch of dark is mine.

lines.zh: 我钻进你脚下的土层里。
lines.en: I burrow into the soil under your feet.
Your shadow moves; I'm watching.
You've turned your back to the light.
I've started burrowing.
That corner suits me.
Your steps are too regular.

lines.zh: 地底下，我先听见你的脚步。
lines.en: Underground, I hear your steps first.
Don't look back.

lines.zh: 石头在我面前，像软土一样。
lines.en: Stone is like soft earth in front of me.
I flatten and wait first.
You're standing right over the crack.
The light won't save you this time.
I count your steps one by one.
I follow you through the soil.
The soil stirs faintly.

lines.zh: 你的脚一停，我就不敢动。
lines.en: Your foot stops, and I freeze.
I circle around your flank.
Your lamp doesn't reach your feet.
I wait for your lamp to die.

lines.zh: 土下到你的鞋底，只差一点。
lines.en: From under the soil I'm a whisker from your sole.
I bite at your shadow.
Do you hear the sand?
I lower my head, ready to rush.

lines.zh: 你再往前一步，就踩到我了。
lines.en: One more step and you're on me.
I withdraw; the light is too bright.
I'm in the soil at your feet.
I twist around and reverse.
Your lamp swings left; I go right.
I creep along the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我背上的沙一动就往下滑。
lines.en: The sand on my back slides off at the least move.
I wait a little; the light will weaken.
I draw my claws in, silent.

lines.zh: 你换了手提灯，我看见了。
lines.en: You switched the lamp hand; I saw.
I burst from the soil and bite.
My teeth sink into your boot.
I butt the back of your knee.
I drag your foot down.
That came from the side.
One bite and I sink back into soil.
I whip my head and pull you off balance.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓着你的小腿。
lines.en: My claws grip your calf.
It pulls back; I follow.
I bite into its armor seam.
I bite your ankle and shake.
I spring from the rear flank.

lines.zh: 牙卡在甲上，我拔了两次。
lines.en: My teeth stick in the plate; I pull twice.
I drag you toward the sand.
This bite lands on the back of your hand.
I sink back, leaving only my tail.

lines.zh: 我撞开一块挡路的石头。
lines.en: I shove aside a stone in my way.
You back off; only then do I show my head.
I come out on the other side.
That bite was shallow, but quick.
A head comes out of the stone wall.
I push up out of the sandy soil.
It's dark here; good.
First I find a crack.
My body is still caked with dirt.
I hear something breathing.
I lower my head and burrow in.
It's too bright; I squint.
I waited a while inside the wall.
I shake the sand off my back.
I peer out through the crack.
My scent is still in the soil.

lines.zh: 火光照得我睁不开眼，我钻下去。
lines.en: The firelight blinds me; I burrow down.
I fall, and the soil falls with me.
Water fills the burrow; I push upward.
The blast cracks the wall open.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边，我缩回去。
lines.en: An arrow lands beside me; I shrink back.

lines.zh: 有光缠住我，我钻不进去。
lines.en: A light binds me; I can't burrow.
I'm too hungry to dig.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我整个人僵了。
lines.en: A flash of lightning freezes me.
There's no soil here, and no wall.
